name: SRNT Annual Meeting 2027
organizer: Society for Research on Nicotine and Tobacco
description: The Society for Research on Nicotine and Tobacco holds its annual meeting in San Francisco, California from March 3 to 6, 2027. The meeting covers nicotine and tobacco research spanning addiction medicine, psychiatry, and psychology.

sources.note: Confirms 2027 meeting dates (March 3 to 6, 2027), San Francisco location, and abstract submission open (June 15, 2026) and close (July 31, 2026) dates; also mentions accept/reject notification mid November 2026 and a rapid submissions window opening December 2026, neither given as exact dates.
